verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, so user-configurable background automations (for example, scheduled compliance or filing workflows) are a fair question for it. The evidence only shows fixed, vendor-run steps such as automatic EIN filing, 83(b) filing, document signing order and share issuance. These are built-in adjacent features, not automations the user can set up, and the pack documents no user-configurable automation capability.
